narratives.Overview:
1. Phase 1 freshness comparison and deft_version stamp/read use locateManifest + parseInstallManifest + manifestReportableVersion (#2294). Remove the 0.20.0 literals from content/skills/deft-directive-setup and content/packs/skills (skills-pack source). Do not invent a generated version file.
2. Stamp / rewrite only when reportable.version is a non-null stampable semver. When version is null (missing manifest, source sha, or source none), ask nothing new and do not rewrite the stamp; on first write omit or leave deft_version unset rather than writing a placeholder. Forbid resolveProbeCurrentVersion / resolveVersion "dev" fallback for USER.md freshness and first-write stamps. Treat Anti-Patterns MUST-set / deft_setup_deft_version_must_rule rewrite as required companion to this omit rule.
3. Narrow Acceptance grep to content/skills/deft-directive-setup plus content/packs/skills (or equivalent skills-pack-only path) so lessons-pack historical v0.20.0-rc.3 lines stay out of this split. Keep detect-then-confirm, import, wizard renderer, and the rest of #4378 off this issue. #4981 needs only this piece.
4. Tests lock: install at X stamps X and second run leaves it; upgrade X→Y restamps Y once after missing-field questions; unreportable version does not rewrite; no 0.20.0 literal remains under the narrowed paths. CHANGELOG Unreleased line. Fixture hygiene under packages/ is optional harvest, not a widen.

## Acceptance grep sweeps lessons history
sharpens-framing
Evidence: At `042eea8c31f5629b1fc0cfa2f75e4cb967af7980`, `git grep '0\.20\.0'` under `content/packs` hits both `content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json` (setup body, three freshness/template sites) and `content/packs/lessons/lessons-pack-0.1.json` (`v0.20.0-rc.3` historical source lines). Issue Acceptance item 1 requires `grep -r "0\.20\.0" content/skills/deft-directive-setup content/packs` to return nothing. Contract clause 1 limits the literal ban to the setup skill and the skills pack for this purpose.
Failure mode: After the three setup literals are removed, Acceptance still fails on unrelated lessons history, or the harvest is forced to rewrite lesson text that is outside this version-stamp split.
Disposition: Narrow Acceptance to `content/skills/deft-directive-setup` plus `content/packs/skills` (or an equivalent skills-pack-only path) so it matches clause 1.

## Null version is sha as well as none
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `git show 042eea8c31f5629b1fc0cfa2f75e4cb967af7980:packages/core/src/doctor/manifest.ts` — `manifestReportableVersion` returns `source: "sha"` with `version: null` for sha-only manifests, and `source: "none"` only when both version and sha are absent. `packages/core/src/doctor/coverage-final.test.ts` locks that four-way classify. `checkManifestVersionReportable` in `packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts` treats sha-only as unreportable semver (advisory fail), same stampable emptiness as no provenance. Issue Contract clause 2 and Acceptance name only reader return `none`.
Failure mode: An implementer who branches only on `source === "none"` still stamps on sha-only installs (empty string, raw sha, or another placeholder), rewriting USER.md and defeating the no-placeholder / no-rewrite rule the split exists to keep.
Disposition: Bind the no-ask / no-rewrite path to `reportable.version === null` (missing manifest, `sha`, and `none`), matching the doctor reportable check’s stampable-semver gate.

## Adjacent probe helper stamps `dev`
sharpens-framing
Evidence: Inventory at the dispatch SHA: the named live reader is `manifestReportableVersion` after `locateManifest` / `parseInstallManifest` (doctor path in `checks.ts`). Adjacent `resolveProbeCurrentVersion` in `packages/core/src/check-updates/index.ts` uses `manifestTagToVersion` then falls through to `resolveVersion` in `packages/core/src/doctor/paths.ts`, which returns the literal `"dev"` when no VERSION candidate reads. Setup remains an agent-executed skill (`content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md`); there is no agent-facing argv that returns only `reportable.version`. Injection / swarm lens: USER.md is shared preference authority; a wrong version read silently rewrites `deft_version` and disables freshness (P2).
Failure mode: Harvest reuses the probe helper as “the live reader,” stamps `dev` on sha-only or missing-manifest installs, and the Acceptance “no readable manifest → do not rewrite” case fails closed only in prose.
Disposition: Before bind, name the stamp seam as locate + parse + `manifestReportableVersion`, stamp only when `version` is non-null, and forbid `resolveProbeCurrentVersion` / `resolveVersion` `"dev"` fallback for USER.md freshness and first-write stamps. A new generated version file stays out of scope.

## Greenfield write when version is null
footnote
Evidence: Anti-Patterns in the setup skill still say `deft_version` MUST be set when generating USER.md; Contract clause 2 / Acceptance only describe no rewrite when the reader returns none. First-write with `version === null` is not named.
Failure mode: Agents may invent a placeholder on greenfield to satisfy the MUST, or skip the field and trip the same anti-pattern.
Disposition: Successor lean can one-line that unreportable installs omit or leave `deft_version` unset on first write as well; not required to block bind if the null-version rule above is stated for every stamp path.

## Fixture literal outside Acceptance paths
footnote
Evidence: `packages/core/src/user-config/experimental-rules.test.ts` still embeds `**deft_version**: 0.20.0` at the dispatch SHA; Acceptance grep does not cover `packages/`.
Failure mode: CI fixtures keep teaching the retired constant after skill/pack cleanup.
Disposition: Harvest hygiene only; no contract recut.

metadata.issueBody:
## Pain

The Phase 1 (USER.md) freshness check compares `deft_version` to "the current framework version", but the deposited skill carries the literal `0.20.0` as that version. A later run on any newer install stamps `0.20.0` back into USER.md and then stops asking, because the stamp now matches the constant. The check silently downgrades and disables itself.

This is the one defect in #4378 that has no design question attached. The #4378 round-1 leans bound it as "fix version stamp with the live reader, not a generated artifact" (5654755223) and left the rest of that RFC (detect-then-confirm, import, wizard renderer) on a recut. #4981 needs only this piece before the Directive Tutorial's second-run acceptance can hold. Split out so the tutorial does not wait on the RFC.

## Evidence (from #4378 critics at e9336c3eb, re-verify at HEAD)

- `content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json` line 321 carries `0.20.0` three times. The rendered `content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md` Phase 1 freshness and template text inherit it. Fixing the rendered skill alone does not fix the pack.
- `packages/core/src/doctor/manifest.ts` already has `manifestReportableVersion()` (#2294), classifying `tag | ref | sha | none`. That is the live reader.
- Newest released heading at that SHA was `0.117.0`; the stamp constant was five minor versions behind the tree it shipped in.

## Contract

1. The freshness comparison and the `deft_version` stamp read the installed framework version through the existing live reader. No version literal remains in the setup skill or the skills pack for this purpose.
2. When the reader returns `none` (no manifest, unknown install), freshness asks nothing new and does not rewrite the stamp. It never writes a placeholder or an older version over a newer one.
3. A second run on the same install leaves `deft_version` unchanged. A run on a newer install updates the stamp once, after the missing-field questions, exactly as the current design intends.

## Not this

- Not detect-then-confirm, import from other agents, provenance fields beyond `deft_version`, a wizard renderer, non-interactive mode, or scoped reset. Those stay on #4378.
- Not a generated version file that the skill reads instead of the manifest. The lean explicitly rejected "a generated reader worse than the bug."
- Not a change to what Phase 1 asks.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `grep -r "0\.20\.0" content/skills/deft-directive-setup content/packs` returns nothing.
- [ ] On an install at version X, a fresh USER.md is stamped X; a second run leaves it X and asks no freshness questions.
- [ ] On an install upgraded from X to Y, one run asks only the missing fields and restamps Y.
- [ ] With no readable manifest, the stamp is not rewritten and the run does not fail.
- [ ] Tests lock the three behaviours above against the live reader.
- [ ] CHANGELOG Unreleased line.

Refs #4378, #4981, #2294
